thread:
Aisha K.: heads up — customer acme-inc reported a sudden stream of 429s after we pushed the new limit-wave policy to eu-west canary at 11:03. They hit ~120 rps bursts and started seeing errors within 2m. Payload: {org: "acme-inc", route: "/v1/generate"}

Ben R.: thanks. do we have the new limit values for that canary? link to rollout?

Devon (eng-platform): rollout id r-2026-03-15-limitwave, canary subset = eu-west-1 small tenants. Policy reduced per-key burst cap from 300->150 for that cohort. pushed via infra/rollout-service at 11:03. ops-bot: deployment r-2026-03-15-limitwave status: success (canary: eu-west-1) :white_check_mark:

Aisha K.: repro steps attached from acme's app:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-123' -d '{"prompt":"x","max_tokens":512}'
```
response: HTTP/1.1 429
{ "error": "quota_exceeded", "retry_after": 30 }

Priya (support): customer says they didn't change traffic pattern — it's normal traffic + a short spike from a batch job. Asking for temporary lift while we investigate.

Ben R.: can you grab token-level metrics for sk-acme-123 between 11:00-11:10? also any proxy 5xx?

Devon (eng-platform): pulling metrics now. preliminary: token throughput peaked at 130 rps, sustained 90 rps. KV-cache hit unchanged. No backend 5xx. Looks like global rate + per-key burst cap clipped them.

Aisha K.: customer wants rollback or a fast bypass — what's safe?

Devon (eng-platform): two options: 1) revert canary policy (fast, affects only canary cohort), 2) increase per-key burst cap for tenant sk-acme-123 temporarily. revert command:
```
# rollback canary policy
rolloutctl rollback --id r-2026-03-15-limitwave --scope canary
```
Increase command (one-off):
```
policectl patch tenant sk-acme-123 --burst-cap 300 --note "support temp lift"
```
Recommend rollback first to verify systemic impact.

Priya (support): I've asked acme for confirmation to accept a short config change. if they approve we'll do the patch. Otherwise we rollback.

ops-bot: runbook-check: rollback preflight OK, automated tests pass, notify channels: #eng-platform #support.

Aisha K.: acme approved temporary patch. Priya — please do the patch and monitor, ping if errors.

Priya (support): applying patch now...
```
policectl patch tenant sk-acme-123 --burst-cap 300 --by support --expires 60m
```

Priya (support): applied. monitoring.

Devon (eng-platform): seeing immediate drop in 429s for sk-acme-123. token success rate back to normal in ~45s. No downstream saturation. :tada:

Aisha K.: customer confirmed — service recovered. we'll keep the temporary lift for 60m and then either bake into next rollout or rollback the change depending on broader telemetry.

Ben R.: log notes: action=temporary_burst_lift actor=Priya target=sk-acme-123 duration=60m rollout=r-2026-03-15-limitwave

Priya (support): closing loop with acme, will file postmortem note and propose a canary traffic shaping tweak (slower ramp + early abort on per-tenant exceed).

Devon (eng-platform): follow-ups: add tenant-exempt list for small set during canary, and add alert rule on per-tenant 429 rate > 5% during rollout window. I'll open tickets.

Aisha K.: thanks team — great runbook response. :slightly_smiling_face:

(ops-bot): ticket created: ENG-4219 "limit-wave canary: post-incident followups" assigned to Devon.
